title: Phetchabun corn farmers demand government price compensation
location: Rahun intersection, Bueng Sam Phan District, Phetchabun Province
scope: Local public gathering; no turnout pooled across sites.

state_target.target: Provincial governor, agencies, MPs and Thai government compensation policy.
